text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet another inspection of youth-oriented 
leisure facilitiesâon this day, we 
visited an outdoor recreation park 
situated right on a sheer cliffside.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
A suspension bridge... excellent for 
building lower body strength and great for 
one's health. However, it might be a bit 
too austere for young people.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I've obtained some good information. 
Let us head back to the academy shortly.
choice_data_list: T-That would really help me out...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I accompanied her to an 
entrepreneurs' party as her collaborator.

text_block_list.name: Male Entrepreneur
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here you are. I heard you were 
visiting, so I wanted to come greet you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you as always for your support. I 
am deeply grateful to you for taking the 
time and trouble to come here."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I hear your business is flourishing as 
well. If I understand correctly, you are 
planning to build a recreational facility 
for young people?

text_block_list.name: Male Entrepreneur
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Were you aware? Actually, we've been 
thinking about launching a new business 
venture...

text_block_list.name: Male Entrepreneur
text_block_list.text:
If possible, as a representative of the 
younger generation, we'd love to hear your 
thoughts! What do you say, Lady Ruby?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ――Understood.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
In our generation, "amusement parks," 
"pools," and "outdoor attractions" do tend 
to be popular choices.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: For example, if it were an amusement park—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"In my personal experience, I believe 
amusement parks are places capable of 
closing the emotional distance between 
visitors."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, if you prepare facilities 
emphasizing 'experiences shared with a 
companion,' I believe it would align well 
with current trends.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I believe themed water parks offer a 
wonderful break from the everyday. Space 
or jungle themes would provide a 
particularly high sense of immersion.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, by installing equipment that 
allows for moderate exercise without being 
too strenuous, I believe the younger 
demographic will thoroughly enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, hosting nighttime events like 
dance parties would add an extra sense of 
novelty for young people—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If we keep social media aesthetics in 
mind, I think we could aim to make it go 
"viral" as well.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Outdoor leisure facilities might not have 
the image of being for young people.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However, nowadays, there is a societal 
trend that values health consciousness. 
The same goes for the younger generation."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Facilities offering wholesome fun can be 
expected to attract visitors of all ages 
and genders.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Though brief, that concludes my remarks. 
Inexperienced though I may be, those are 
my thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I would be glad if this was of any help to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby stated her opinion with 
dignified composure. No matter who her 
opponent was or where she stood, her true 
self remained unwavering.

text_block_list.name: Male Entrepreneur
text_block_list.text:
Well, well! This has been extremely 
informative!!

text_block_list.name: Male Entrepreneur
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a young lady from a 
prestigious family. You have such a clear 
and solid vision for the future. Please 
give my warmest regards to your parents.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The party was over, and on the way back—
choice_data_list: That was a huge success, huh!
That was a huge success, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It is a natural outcome.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...On my own, I likely would never have 
thought to ask Ines-san or Helios-san for 
help."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I believe it was precisely because of your 
words, Trainer, that we were able to 
gather so much valuable feedback.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Taking everything into account, thank you 
very much for this opportunity.
choice_data_list: The honor was mine, I'm glad I could help.

I'm always happy to help if it's just 
something like this.
I can't believe I'm getting praised!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I would be deeply honored if you felt that 
way.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, and one more thing. They asked if 
you'd be willing to share your impressions 
once the facility is complete."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, I look forward to 
working with you again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She never wavers, no matter what happens. 
She might not need it, but I resolved to 
keep supporting her by her side.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I truly appreciate all your hard work 
regarding this matter."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
However, you have important duties of your 
own as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I have no intention of troubling you any 
further from now on, Trainer. Please rest 
assured."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was probably right. Even so, I 
silently vowed to continue supporting her 
if anything ever happened.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Gratitude for the kindness received is 
only natural.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I do not believe this warrants being quite 
so overwhelmed with emotion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That answer was so very like her. Our 
relationship would likely always remain 
this way. Thinking that, I began my walk 
home.
